candidate_decisions.title: Microsoft Lazarus dormant-neuron agent backdoor
candidate_decisions.reason: Public research, code and exact timestamp create a new agent-security event.

candidate_decisions.title: Token pooling-aware multi-vector retrieval
candidate_decisions.reason: Public code, checkpoints and evaluation scripts create a testable RAG decision.

candidate_decisions.title: Qwen4-Max-Preview
candidate_decisions.reason: A timestamped, callable preview creates a bounded model option; retirement and Token Plan limits keep it WATCH.

candidate_decisions.title: BotPsy-0.8B
candidate_decisions.reason: Apache 2.0 BF16 and GGUF weights make the small tool model directly testable.

candidate_decisions.title: Gemini CLI 0.68.0
candidate_decisions.reason: Extension, path, file and fallback changes materially alter upgrade regression tests.

candidate_decisions.title: Qwen Code 0.27.2
candidate_decisions.reason: Channels, Mods, recaps and approval notifications expand runtime and authority boundaries.

candidate_decisions.title: LiteLLM 1.109.0
candidate_decisions.reason: Stream fallback and offline mode arrive with five required migrations.

candidate_decisions.title: Anthropic proposed IPO terms and Google agreement
candidate_decisions.reason: Proposed range and signed-but-unclosed Google agreement materially update the financing judgment.

candidate_decisions.title: Codex 0.167.1
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable patch has no published material changelog; alpha builds remain prerelease.

candidate_decisions.title: Ollama 0.40.17 release candidate
candidate_decisions.reason: Only a release candidate appeared; it does not supersede stable.

candidate_decisions.title: NVIDIA DSX Runtime AI Inventory
candidate_decisions.reason: Operational guidance did not establish a distinct product, availability or pricing change.

candidate_decisions.title: NVIDIA Kimi-K3.1-Pro-NVFP4
candidate_decisions.reason: A new derivative checkpoint had no independent evaluation or upstream availability change.

candidate_decisions.title: PAN 2 open video model
candidate_decisions.reason: Official page has date-only precision; publication before the 17:04Z cutoff cannot be confirmed.

candidate_decisions.title: Australia mandatory AI standards announcement
candidate_decisions.reason: Date-only publication precision prevents hour-window attribution, and legislation is not yet in force.

candidate_decisions.title: Other fixed official monitors
candidate_decisions.reason: All fetched monitors were read; remaining changes were old, duplicate, dynamic or below threshold.

candidate_decisions.title: Additional active discovery
candidate_decisions.reason: Search covered models, tools, research, open source, infrastructure, policy, small teams and multilingual primary sources; no other window-valid fact met the threshold.

candidate_decisions.title: Exceptional general-news review
candidate_decisions.reason: No verified general-news event met the exceptional broad-impact threshold.

candidate_decisions.title: Notion says a Fireworks AI incident exposed some customer chat transcripts
candidate_decisions.reason: Recall audit found a primary-source security incident with customer chat exposure; recorded as late discovery.

candidate_decisions.title: Cactus releases a 22 MB local vision model for structured extraction
candidate_decisions.reason: Recall audit found public weights, code and meaningful early adoption; recorded as late discovery.

candidate_decisions.title: Google SWE points 48 AI agents at NASA Lidar, finds unmapped Maya pyramid in 72h
candidate_decisions.reason: High-interest real-world agent claim comes from an unaffiliated project page; institutional confirmation and reproducible evidence are still missing.

candidate_decisions.title: AI usage generates a fragile codebase
candidate_decisions.reason: Personal essay provides observations rather than a controlled study or new technical artifact.

candidate_decisions.title: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
candidate_decisions.reason: Secondary reporting describes an unreleased Apple application; no primary announcement or downloadable product was verified.

candidate_decisions.title: Tracking Anthropic-discovered vulnerabilities
candidate_decisions.reason: The secondary tracker is useful discovery material, but this run did not verify a new vendor advisory, CVE or independently confirmed impact.

candidate_decisions.title: Show HN: Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
candidate_decisions.reason: The repository was created in March and the current discussion reflects renewed attention, not a new release or material window change.

candidate_decisions.title: Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data
candidate_decisions.reason: The official page has only a November 10 date; publication after the previous checkpoint cannot be established at hourly precision.

candidate_decisions.title: ChatGPT Desktop forwards your SSH agent to remote machines
candidate_decisions.reason: Discussion-only SSH-agent forwarding report still lacks an official advisory or controlled independent reproduction.

candidate_decisions.title: Fireworks AI security breach impacts Notion and their customers
candidate_decisions.reason: The official Notion and Fireworks disclosures are stored as ev-20261109-08.

candidate_decisions.title: A year after the 100% AI mandate nobody understands our code
candidate_decisions.reason: Anonymous community anecdote does not establish a measurable code-quality event.

candidate_decisions.title: DeepX claims inference up to 100B parameters at less than 5 W
candidate_decisions.reason: Tape-out and efficiency claims remain secondary reporting; production availability and primary technical evidence are incomplete.

candidate_decisions.title: What objective is reasoning solving?
candidate_decisions.reason: Conceptual essay offers an interpretation of reasoning but no new evaluation, model or engineering artifact.

candidate_decisions.title: Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3-Image
candidate_decisions.reason: This is a ComfyUI packaging of the existing MiniMax H3 image-model family recorded in ev-20261027-11.

candidate_decisions.title: VideoRebirthAI/hyperflow-h3-flash
candidate_decisions.reason: Older derivative weights add no verified upstream release or independent evaluation.

candidate_decisions.title: tencent/Qwen3.8-27B-DSpine-b16
candidate_decisions.reason: Public checkpoint predates overlap; end-to-end throughput and quality claims still need independent reproduction.

candidate_decisions.title: ConwayResearch/Underdog-Woof
candidate_decisions.reason: The compact public TTS model predates overlap and its publisher comparison still needs an independent audio and WER check.

candidate_decisions.title: Comfy-Org/RelayVSR
candidate_decisions.reason: The repository repackages existing RelayVSR weights for ComfyUI without a new upstream model or independent evaluation.
